claims: St. John's University is a private Roman Catholic, Vincentian institution.
St. John's University is in Queens, NY.
St. John's University was founded in 1870.
St. John's University has a 100-acre residential campus in NYC.
St. John's University's main campus is in Queens (NYC).
St. John's University has locations in Manhattan, Staten Island, Rome, Paris, and Seville.
St. John's University offers 100+ programs in liberal arts, sciences, business, education, and pharmacy.
PrepScholar and U.S. News & World Report note that St. John's University has an 83% acceptance rate.
PrepScholar and U.S. News & World Report note that St. John's University generally looks for a 3.5 GPA.
PrepScholar and U.S. News & World Report note that St. John's University has SAT scores between 1150-1340.
According to U.S. News & World Report, St. John's University's student body is 55.8% female.
According to U.S. News & World Report, St. John's University's student body is 44.2% male.
St. John's University athletics are known as the "Red Storm."
The "Red Storm" competes in the Big East Conference.
Tuition for St. John's University for the 2023–2024 academic year was $50,110, as listed by this source.
